description: This source file provides utility functions for formatting currency amounts, especially USD, with dynamic decimal precision, optional inclusion of credits for USD amounts, and consistent display across an application. It includes functions for formatting values as currency strings, appending credits, and handling edge cases like invalid inputs.

methods.name: formatCurrencyAmount(value, options = {})
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a currency string, with optional inclusion of credits if currency is USD and includeCredits is true. Handles dynamic precision based on value magnitude.

methods.name: formatUsdWithCreditsText(usd, options = {})
methods.description: A convenience function to format a USD amount with appended credits, utilizing formatCurrencyAmount.

methods.name: formatUsdUpToSixDecimals(amount)
methods.description: Formats a USD amount with up to six decimal places, including thousands separators.
